## How to check

- [ ] `make lint-slop` passes

- [ ] No user-facing string claims a certain outcome
- [ ] New claims in UI copy cite a source URL and a timestamp, or they do not ship
- [ ] Credentials, session cookies, and API keys are not logged, committed, or sent off the machine
